title: Retouched and Revitalized, Washington Looks Forward
abstract: A host of new restaurants, hotels and entertainment venues in the nation’s capital are just now spreading their wings.

title: In the Mile High City, Festivals and Food Are on the Rise
abstract: Denver has regained its prepandemic vibrancy, with a plethora of new restaurants and hotels, and the return of some old favorites.

title: Berlin, Back in Full Swing
abstract: Berlin’s 178 museums, seven symphony orchestras and three opera houses are once again up and running, along with a flourishing restaurant and nightclub scene.

title: New Faces, New Places, as Boston Gets Revitalized
abstract: In New England’s largest city, there are exciting music venues, a floating oyster bar and newcomers on the arts and restaurant scenes that reflect its diversity.
